buildAndCommitVerification.normalization: Production source/build inputs compare exact local bytes against build record; commit comparison normalizes CRLF to LF. Development-only tools are committed separately and excluded from this production source match.

limitations: This is a compact export; full local captures and immutable manifests remain in the evidence directory.
Strict GPU comparison and performance runs precede three presentation-only fixes; validationReuse records their exact files.
No new-build Shopify preview, backend receipts/history reconciliation or physical-device acceptance.

gpu.method: Exact captured scene, all fish fields, instanceMatrix/aSwim, post-reset RNG count/state and sonarTime; decoded original PNG RGB 0..255 absolute difference.
gpu.metadata_policy: Capture/init clock, frame counters, pending RAF, startup RNG and subscriber counts are retained for protocol audit but are not classified as model inequality. The additional lifecycle subscriber is expected.
limitations: The QA harness queues RAF before initialization and explicitly advances the actual R3F normal-running loop; it is not release performance or natural user input timing.
This compares captured fields and rendered images at these steps; it does not recreate an independent hit algorithm or prove all asynchronous AUTO/physics timelines.
No preset pixel tolerance converts nonzero differences into equality; RGB equality is exact, >8 only a review metric.
Event equality describes captured local lists only, not backend delivery or historical statistics.

conditions.device: Windows desktop, AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 31.1 GiB RAM
conditions.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (0x00002F04) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
conditions.network: localhost HTTP/1.1, uncompressed, Cache-Control:no-store, no throttling
conditions.cache: fresh document per run; existing browser process and driver caches warm; not a cold-device measurement
conditions.scene: PL Forward, default desktop boat (-6,4), 80ft manual range, gain40%, AUTO depth; real clock
conditions.samples: 3 before and 3 after; 120 RAF intervals per run after cover removal, about 2.1 seconds

metrics.coverRemoved: presentation milestone only, NOT TTI or GPU readiness
metrics.shaderCalls: compileShader/linkProgram synchronous JS call durations, not GPU compilation completion
metrics.interaction: pointerdown to view event and two RAF callbacks; not calibrated input latency
metrics.parse: not independently instrumented; navigation domInteractive is not pure parse time

method.groupSummary: Median and minimum-maximum of three run-level measurements; not pooled frame samples.
method.frameP50: Median of 120 frame intervals per run (average of central pair).
method.frameP95: Nearest rank ceil(0.95 * 120)-1 in zero-based sorted sample; rank 114.
method.timeOrigin: Navigation start for milestones; individual durations otherwise. All timing values in milliseconds.
method.variabilityCheck: Descriptive only: compare median change to observed within-group ranges, and report whether sample ranges overlap. No significance test, confidence interval or causal inference from n=3.
method.ordering: Before and after collected in separate blocks; first run navigated, remaining runs reloaded. Process/driver caches already warm.
method.runtimeVersion: After artifacts are a worktree snapshot referenced by final-build-report.json, not a claim that production runs the same commit.

budgets.scope: 120 RAF intervals per run, about 2.1 seconds; not the proposed 10-second steady-state acceptance.
One warmed-up mode-selection interaction per run, not calibrated input-to-pixel latency.
Localhost contentful paint with warm browser process/driver caches, not remote-network LCP.

interpretation.confidence: High for computed local descriptive results and budget checks; low for causal improvement claims or extrapolation to production/mobile.
interpretation.overall: This sample meets the three local short-window budgets; it does not establish an overall speedup. Core timing medians change within observed run variation, and initialization long tasks remain.
interpretation.remaining: Largest initialization tasks remain 738-770 ms across runs. Sustained performance, true readiness, GPU completion, physical devices and Shopify delivery are unmeasured.
interpretation.heap: After JS heap snapshots are higher, but capture times and garbage collection are not controlled; this is an observed resource signal, not evidence of a leak or steady-state regression.
